messages:
marta: Quick idea 10min: ship a compact networking handshake checklist for private deploys (VPC/on-prem) so field can onboard faster. Goal: cut the back-and-forth with customer netops.

claire: +1. Keep it terse: 1-page checklist + sample netops email + a validation script. Must call out upgrade safety and IP continuity assumptions.

devon: Technical bind: we can guarantee IP continuity only on the typed upgrade path where LB IP reuse is supported. I'll add a per-cloud caveat section. Also will produce a small `verify-ips.sh` kubectl script.

lina: Field note: customers appreciate a single contact flow line: who from us talks to them, who they should CC, and the exact maintenance-window format. Add that to the one-pager.

marta: Draft outline I propose:
- Quick summary (what this checklist guarantees)
- Precheck (IAM bits, peering creds, netops contact)
- Upgrade window runbook (order: control-plane canary -> KV warm -> data-plane)
- Post-upgrade validation steps (run `verify-ips.sh`, smoke test)
- Fallback options (relay tech-preview + roll-back triggers)
- Known-cloud caveats + links

claire: Also include a short consent clause for BYO-KMS and where to place audit-log endpoints. Security needs will ask.

devon: I'll own the `verify-ips.sh` and the signed-off cloud caveats. Will mark steps that require netops windows.

lina: I'll turn the outline into a one-page PDF and add the email template. I'll also draft a quick escalation flow: if handoff fails, call engineering and attach `--collect-logs` command.

marta: Ops-bot, please capture as a ticket and assign owners.

ops-bot: Created RDW-PL-9999 "Compact private-deploy networking handshake checklist"  assignees: @marta @devon @lina. ETA: 6bd.

marta: Great. If we can get a usable draft by Thu I can run it with field this week. Ping here if blockers. :shipit:
